entities.name: ENO1
observations: α-Enolase has a glycolytic function and reported non-catalytic mitochondrial/AMPK-related roles in doxorubicin cardiotoxicity.

entities.name: PMID:25446184
observations: In rat hearts and primary cardiomyocytes, ENO1 silencing reduced doxorubicin-induced apoptosis and mitochondrial dysfunction; overexpression of wild-type or catalytically inactive ENO1 increased apoptosis and reduced ATP, with AMPK dephosphorylation implicated.

entities.name: PMID:24361255
observations: Rat cardiomyocyte study found mitochondrial ENO1 stabilizes membrane integrity and interacts with VDAC1; doxorubicin displaced ENO1 from mitochondria, associated with intrinsic apoptosis.
